if/elseif/else, combined conditions, ! negation, $v1/$v2 and operators.
-- origin --
spec
-- script.mrc --
alias number {
  if ($1 == 1) echo -s One
  elseif ($1 == 2) echo -s Two
  else echo -s Unknown number!
}
alias range {
  if (($1 > 0) && ($1 < 10)) {
    if ($1 < 5) echo -s less than five
    else echo -s greater than five
  }
  else echo -s out of bounds
}
alias test {
  number 1
  number 2
  number 7
  range 3
  range 8
  range 12
  if (!%nothing) echo -s x has no value
  if (text isin sometext) echo -s $v1 in $v2
  if (*.com iswm irc.example.com) echo -s wild
  if (3 // 9) echo -s multiple
  if (2 \\ 9) echo -s not multiple
  if (5 isnum 1-10) echo -s in range
  if (Abc === abc) echo -s wrong
  else echo -s case-sensitive differs
  if (ABC == abc) echo -s case-insensitive equal
  if (10 > 9) echo -s numeric compare
  if (b !isin abc) echo -s wrong
  else echo -s negated operator
}
-- output --
One
Two
Unknown number!
less than five
greater than five
out of bounds
x has no value
text in sometext
wild
multiple
not multiple
in range
case-sensitive differs
case-insensitive equal
numeric compare
negated operator
